title: Runtime deployment and the minimal bootstrap boundary
summary: ooRexx itself is a runtime requirement and Deployment must support staging the runtime that executes application code without assuming a pre-existing remote rexx. A deliberately small bootstrap may transfer Deployment, stage the required runtime and invoke the ooRexx entry point; after that, ordinary Deployment objects own reconciliation.
invariants: Do not assume remote ooRexx is already correctly installed merely because deployment code is written in ooRexx.
Prefer explicitly staged executables over ambient PATH when a manifest defines one.
Record the exact resolved executable path used for launch.
Bootstrap is transport/runtime bootstrapping, not application deployment semantics.
Do not reinstall an already-satisfied exact runtime merely because an installer path exists.

provenance.claim: Defines general and private runtime requirements and exact executable resolution.
Defines ooRexx runtime deployment and the minimal bootstrap boundary.
